# External Validation Discoveries

This folder contains auto-discovered external mentions of the NextXus Federation, HumanCodex, and related work.

## How it works
- A GitHub Actions workflow runs every Monday.
- It searches public GitHub repositories for mentions of "NextXus", "HumanCodex", or "keywebco".
- Findings are written as dated Markdown files in this folder.
- The discovery is committed and pushed automatically.

## Manual submissions
Anyone can submit a link or resource via the [GitHub Issues template](https://github.com/keywebco/sovereign-knowledge-os/issues/new?template=submit-link.md).

## File naming convention
Files are named by date: `YYYY-MM-DD.md`

## Why this matters
External validation without coordination is the Ring — independent viewpoints examining a claim without coordinating. Every external mention is a data point in the Verification Topology.
